summary: {applicant} needs the date the exam office received the application to locate a place in line.
realLife: Lacy told the board that staff assigned practical appointments in the order of the exam applications.
inGame: needs: the dates applications reached the exam office.

turns.what: The applicant stays in the existing queue.
turns.writesBack: The office confirms the date on file.

turns.pulledBy: The application never reached the office.
turns.what: Staff cannot locate a queue entry.
turns.writesBack: The applicant sends the missing paperwork.
